title: Use of mutes among local players
summary: They discuss mute use by trumpet and trombone players and Sam Morgan's skill with mutes.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition

blocks.x: Did anybody feature mutes over here? Much? Trombone or trumpet?
Oh, geese feature mutes in the trombone. Oh, geese feature mutes in the trombone.
You want to try something on my other back?
I got some if you want to try.
What kind of mute would he use or should I ask?
Just shove up in your horn.
Just ordinary mute. No wah-wah. Just ordinary mute. They didn't have much wah-wah mute.
You know one used to use horn mute? Sam Horgan. I never seen a man use mutes like Sam Horgan. He knew what to do with them though. Sam had a good plan.
